head: 7 new productivity apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These productivity apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Productivity charts this week, from 2Do: To Do List & Task Manager to Foreweek: Weekly Planner.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store charts this week
means: If you're looking for something new in productivity, these are small apps people are buying right now.
todo: Open each app's App Store page to check the price, in-app purchases and what it needs before you download.

list.name: 2Do: To Do List & Task Manager
list.what: A task manager for simple lists or a full GTD system; it needs a subscription.

list.name: Ellipsus
list.what: A creative writing app for writing with co-authors, editors and beta readers.

list.name: Bare
list.what: A shopping list that sorts items by store section as you type.

list.name: ShiftBoard: Shift Calendar
list.what: Puts firefighter, EMT and dispatcher shift rotations on one calendar.

list.name: GoaTime
list.what: Tasks, daily planning and time tracking in one app.

list.name: Calendaria
list.what: Shows your whole year as one continuous calendar list.

list.name: Foreweek: Weekly Planner
list.what: A weekly planner for a few goals that make the week a success.
